## Summary

Describe the user problem and the change.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Relevant keyboard, responsive, and error states checked

## Risk review

- [ ] No secrets, user payloads, or generated build artifacts committed
- [ ] Privacy, security, accessibility, compatibility, and performance impact assessed
- [ ] Platform capability declarations and host permissions updated when exposure changed
- [ ] Persisted preference changes include validation, migration, and downgrade behavior
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when public behavior changed
